core_obligations: Base dim(Supp)=0: the function is constant with value dim_k Gamma(X, F) by the delivered chi-tensor-finite lemma (proof lines 10210-10282).

Embedded points: remove them with the Divisors short exact sequence; K has strictly smaller support so induction applies, and additivity of the Euler characteristic reduces to F'; may assume no embedded associated points.
Closed immersion: chi agreement under i_* reduces to Z = Supp(F) with no embedded components (Cohomology of Schemes relative-affine cohomology; Divisors no-embedded-points endos).

Difference trick: a regular meromorphic section of L_1 gives injective maps with cokernels supported nowhere dense; additivity shows each first finite difference of P in any variable is a numerical polynomial of strictly smaller total degree; the standard finite-difference arithmetic argument closes that P itself is a numerical polynomial of total degree at most dim(Supp(F)).
proof_roadmap: Induction on support dimension: constant base; strip embedded points; descend along closed immersions; meromorphic-section difference sequence; finite-difference close.
